trello.name: Fix staging deploy by updating CI registry token
trello.desc: Regenerate the expired registry token, update the CI secret with the new token, and re-run the staging deploy job. The deploy job has been red since this morning due to a failure pulling the base image. Owner: Ade. Deadline: within one hour. Acceptance criteria: staging deploy job turns green and developers can test again.

trello.name: Send updated Meridian proposal with new pricing to Lena
trello.desc: Take the final pricing numbers from the spreadsheet and drop them into the proposal doc, then send the updated proposal to Meridian's procurement contact Lena (email available from the kickoff thread). Owner: Ade. Deadline: end of day today. Acceptance criteria: updated proposal doc with new pricing is sent to Lena by EOD.
